info.title: Reporting platform API
info.summary: The HTTP API of the reporting platform under /api/reporting/v1, and the production server's health and readiness.
info.description:
Written from the handlers in transport/httpapi and server/http.go; docs/API.md is the prose reference and wins where they differ, which TestOpenAPIMatchesTheBoundRoutes (transport/httpapi/openapi_test.go) and TestOpenAPIMatchesTheHealthRoutes (server/openapi_test.go) keep from happening for the routes themselves. `x-reporting-mount` names the handler that binds an operation: `core` is httpapi.Handler, `layouts` its optional layout store, the others the With* mounts, `server` the production server only. A deployment serves only the mounts it composes; a route it does not compose is 404.

Every answer carries `Cache-Control: no-store`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, `Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'none'` (or a policy of the route's own that includes it) and exactly one `X-Reporting-Data-Class` (`contract-simulator`, or `business-data` on a production server that allows no simulator). JSON answers are `application/json; charset=utf-8`. An unknown path or method is the Go mux's plain-text 404 or 405.

servers.description: The API listener: the console, the API under /api/reporting/v1 and, on the production server, /healthz and /readyz.

get.summary: Download an artifact
get.description: Re-authorizes the whole scope and checks the expiry. An issued PDF is named `issued-<issue id>.pdf`. The file of an issue that was cancelled is not handed out: 409 ISSUE_CANCELLED (S24-A, ADR 0025 decision 4); the issue's record goes on saying its number, digest and page count.

200.description: The file, with its exact length and digest.

409.description: INTEGRITY_FAILURE (the file's time has passed, or the file or its record does not verify) or ISSUE_CANCELLED (the artifact is the file of an issue that was cancelled; said for as long as the file is held, without asking the source).

get.summary: The audit of people's actions, newest first (S12-B, ADR 0018)
get.description: The caller's own events; with `scope=tenant` (the administrator role, else 403 AUTH_ROLE_DENIED) every event of the caller's tenant and issuer, each with its `subject`. A publication, a withdrawal and an official issue are recorded before they run (`requested`) and refused with 503 AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE when that fails; every recorded action also gets its outcome. 404 when the server keeps no audit.

get.description: Under the catalog's authority: only a product explicitly allowed for the principal, the same refusals. An adapter without the capability answers 200 with `supported` false and an empty list. The list is advisory: a read still names company ids and the source authorizes it as before; nothing of the list is stored or logged, and the answer is never cached. post.summary: Admit an export job of a snapshot
post.description: `format` absent or `xlsx` is the workbook; `pdf` needs a server started with PDF (listed in `formats`); other values are 422. `layout_id` (S23-A, ADR 0024) names a layout of the caller's own or the tenant's shared space whose latest saved version the file is rendered through (its columns, labels, alignments, formats, subtotal rows, marks, title and footnote); the job and the artifact record the layout version (`layout` in the job view) and the Idempotency-Key binds it: the same key with another version, or without the layout, is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. A layout the caller cannot read is 404; one bound to another integration or dataset than the snapshot, or a format whose writer cannot present (none of the shipped ones), is 422 UNSUPPORTED_COMBINATION; one that no longer fits its dataset's rules is 400; without a layout store on the server a `layout_id` is 422. Without `layout_id` the file is byte for byte what it was before layouts (the PDF), or the whole snapshot (the workbook, which since S23-A writes typed cells beside exact columns in every case). The file of a snapshot whose query has filters or a sort says that scope (S20-C, ADR 0023 decision 6), with or without a layout: the workbook's `Metadata` sheet ends with `query_scope | filters | n | sort_keys | m` (in every workbook; 0 and 0 without filters and sort) and a row per filter and sort key with the words and the exact field, operator and value; the PDF prints the filters and the sort in words under the meta line of the first page (at most 6 and 2 lines; a longer list says its count, lists the first whole items that fit and says that the rest are in the snapshot's query and the workbook's Metadata sheet) and counts them beside the snapshot's id in the footer of every page. A filter value or a label the PDF's fonts do not cover fails the PDF job with UNSUPPORTED_COMBINATION.

requestBody.description: JSON (`Content-Type: application/json`). Unknown or case-mismatched fields, duplicate keys, `null`, extra roots and excessive nesting are 400. At most 4 KiB; a larger body is 413 REQUEST_TOO_LARGE.

layout_id.description: S23-A: the layout whose latest saved version the export is rendered through. Absent means the whole snapshot.

post.summary: Ask the source product to cancel an issued document
post.description: S24-A (ADR 0025 decisions 1 to 4). An `issuer`'s, for an issue of the caller's own that succeeded. The platform asks the issue's source product within the request and the product decides; with the product's receipt it records the cancellation beside the issue record (which keeps every field) and answers the issue as `GET /issues/{id}` shows it, with `cancellation`. Asking again answers the same and does not ask the product again. The file of a cancelled issue is no longer handed out (`GET /artifacts/{id}/content` is 409 ISSUE_CANCELLED); the number stays used. Recorded in the audit as `issue.cancel`: `requested` before the product is asked (503 AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE when that cannot be written, and nothing is asked) and `succeeded` with the cancellation, in one step. No Idempotency-Key: the issue id is the key. See docs/API.md "Cancelling an issued document".

requestBody.description: JSON (`Content-Type: application/json`). Unknown or case-mismatched fields, duplicate keys, `null`, extra roots and excessive nesting are 400. At most 4 KiB; a larger body is 413 REQUEST_TOO_LARGE.

200.description: The issue with its cancellation: the one just recorded, or the one recorded before.

403.description: AUTH_ROLE_DENIED: the caller is not an `issuer`. AUTH_SCOPE_DENIED: the caller no longer holds the issue's product, or the product refuses (the person may not cancel there, or the product's own rules say no). Nothing is recorded.

409.description: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: the issue job has not succeeded (queued, running, failed or cancelled before it ran: there is no issued document), or the product does not hold the document as a confirmed one. INTEGRITY_FAILURE: the product's answer cannot be trusted (a receipt that does not verify, a job it says it never reserved, another receipt than the one recorded). Nothing is recorded.

422.description: UNSUPPORTED_COMBINATION: the issue's product cannot be asked for a cancellation (`issue_cancellation` is false for it in the capabilities). Nothing is asked.

503.description: AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE: the product did not answer; nothing is recorded, and whether it cancelled is found by asking again. AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE: the audit event could not be written; when the product had already cancelled, asking again completes the record with the product's same receipt. OVERLOADED: the process's in-flight bound (`Retry-After: 1`).

get.summary: Liveness
get.description: No authentication and no dependency touched; not served by the demo.

get.description: No authentication; not served by the demo. The object store's last answer is cached for 10 seconds.

get.summary: How the console starts a browser sign-in
get.description: Unauthenticated and never cached. The core API answers {"enabled": false}; WithSignIn, mounted when the deployment configures sign_in, answers the public sign-in configuration in its place.

post.summary: Exchange an authorization code for an access token
post.description: Unauthenticated; mounted only with sign_in (else the mux's 404). The server sends the code, the verifier, the configured redirect URI and client id to the configured token endpoint (HTTPS, at most 10 seconds by default, an answer of at most 64 KiB, no redirect followed) and answers the access token only when its own verifier accepts it. A code is redeemed at most once per process. A refusal is a fixed code; nothing of the provider's answer is repeated.

requestBody.description: At most 4 KiB.

400.description: INVALID_REQUEST (a body or field out of its bounds) or SIGN_IN_REFUSED (the provider refused the code or the verifier, or the ID token's nonce is not the one sent).

403.description: SIGN_IN_TOKEN_REFUSED: the provider issued a token this server's verifier does not accept (issuer, audience, keys, bindings or scope).

409.description: SIGN_IN_REPLAYED: this code was already presented to this server.

502.description: SIGN_IN_UNAVAILABLE: the provider did not answer in time, could not be reached, answered a server error or an answer that is not a Bearer token answer.

503.description: SIGN_IN_BUSY (with Retry-After: 1): too many exchanges at once, or OVERLOADED.

parameters.name: before

post.summary: Make a schedule (S16-A)
post.description: The query is checked against the published catalog as the caller (no row is read); each run freezes it as its owner at its occurrence, through the same admission as POST /snapshot-jobs, then exports it when `export_format` is set. At most `schedules.per_identity` schedules that are not deleted (429 QUOTA_EXCEEDED, quota `schedules`). The same Idempotency-Key and request give the same schedule.

requestBody.description: JSON (`Content-Type: application/json`), held to the schema strictly (unknown fields, duplicate keys and `null` are 400). At most 64 KiB.

get.summary: One of the caller's schedules

delete.description: No body. The schedule no longer runs, is no longer found and no longer counts against the limit; a run already started finishes, one that was due and not started is cancelled. The jobs and results of its runs stay the owner's.

post.summary: Pause a schedule
post.description: No body. The schedule no longer runs until it is resumed; `next_run_at` is absent.

post.summary: Resume a schedule
post.description: No body. The query is checked against the catalog again; the next run is the first occurrence after now (what was missed while paused is not run).

get.summary: A schedule's runs, newest occurrence first
get.description: Each run names the jobs it submitted (GET /jobs/{id}) and, once they succeeded, their snapshot (GET /snapshots/{id}/rows) and artifact (GET /artifacts/{id}/content), read by the owner with the owner's own access.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The last id of the previous page.

get.summary: The configuration in force, read-only, for an administrator (S18-B)
get.description: The administrator role, else 403 AUTH_ROLE_DENIED (recorded as `role.refused`). The product connections and the bindings of the caller's tenant, the SHA-256 digests the start and reload log lines give for the connections and the bindings file, when the server started and when the bindings were last loaded, and whether scheduled reports, their webhook and the browser sign-in are configured. Nothing writes a connection or a binding through the API (ADR 0016); the view carries no secret, no adapter option, no key and of the webhook only its host. A query is 400.

200.description: The configuration in force for the caller's tenant.

bearerAuth.description: The production server verifies an access JWT against its configured issuers and bindings (docs/ACCESS_JWT.md). Demo only: reporting-demo accepts one random shared secret as the bearer token (httpapi.DemoBearer), a synthetic identity that is not SSO.

Kind.name: kind
Kind.description: A sample kind of the pack (GET /document-templates/samples).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Exactly one, with no surrounding space. The same key and request give the same job; the same key with another request is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

Version.name: version
Version.description: The version to read; the only query parameter.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before trying again.

XContentSHA256.description: The SHA-256 of the body, in lowercase hexadecimal.

BadRequest.description: INVALID_REQUEST: a malformed body, query or header.

Unauthorized.description: No bearer token, or one that does not verify: `{"error":"AUTH_SCOPE_DENIED"}` with `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="reporting"` (with `error="invalid_token"` when a bearer token was sent).

Forbidden.description: AUTH_SCOPE_DENIED: the caller may not read this product, dataset or field, or the token lacks the scope (`WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="reporting", error="insufficient_scope"`).

NotFound.description: NOT_FOUND: nothing of the caller's has this id. Another identity's object is not found, not denied.

Conflict.description: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT (a key reused for another request), INTEGRITY_FAILURE, LEASE_LOST or TEMPLATE_NOT_PUBLISHED; a stale `expected_version` or `expected_revision`.

TooLarge.description: REQUEST_TOO_LARGE (the body is over its route's bound) or BUDGET_EXCEEDED (a result or an upload over its budget).

Unsupported.description: UNSUPPORTED_COMBINATION: a shape, format or capability this deployment or integration does not offer. A template refusal carries `detail`.

QuotaExceeded.description: QUOTA_EXCEEDED with the quota's name; `Retry-After: 60` (`1` for queries_in_flight).

ExecutionFailed.description: EXECUTION_FAILED: an error the server does not classify.

Unavailable.description: AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE (the source's authority or the object store did not answer; the object store's has `Retry-After: 10`) or OVERLOADED (the process's in-flight bound, refused before authentication; `Retry-After: 1`).

Id.description: An identifier the server assigns: 32 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

Sha256.description: A SHA-256 digest in lowercase hexadecimal.

ErrorCode.description: The code of a refusal (`classify` in transport/httpapi/api.go). OVERLOADED is the in-flight bound's 503 (WithMaxInFlight); METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED is only answered by /healthz and /readyz. The SIGN_IN_* codes are answered only by POST /sign-in/token. AUTH_ROLE_DENIED (S12-A) is the 403 of a route whose role the caller lacks; AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE (S12-B) the 503 of an action that must not run unrecorded when its audit event cannot be written; ISSUE_CANCELLED (S24-A) the 409 of the download of a cancelled issue's file.

quota.description: Present only with QUOTA_EXCEEDED: the quota that was reached.

Error.description: The body of every refusal: the code, and nothing of the request's values.

reason.description: Why the layout or binding was refused, for example DOES_NOT_FIT, NOT_COVERED, INCONSISTENT_GROUP, TOO_MANY_PAGES or BAND_OVERFLOW.

Detail.description: Where a template refusal happened (S03-J): a reason and names and indices, never a value (doctemplates.Detail).

Binding.description: The integration and dataset a saved document reads.

integrations.description: The principal's integrations that the server has a connection for (ADR 0016), in the principal's order.

profile.description: `S01-B-contract-simulators` for the core API and the demo; the production server's `profile_label`, or `simulated:<label>` when it allows a simulator.

formats.description: The export formats: `xlsx` first when the workbook writer is configured, then the others sorted (for example `pdf`).

issuance.description: Whether the server has an issuer; whether an integration can issue is its adapter's capability.

issue_cancellation.description: S24-A (ADR 0025 decision 5): for each product the server serves for the caller (the session's integrations), whether a cancellation of an issued document can be asked of it (its connection has the capability). It promises nothing about one document: the product decides each request.

embedding.description: True when embedding is configured for at least one of the caller's integrations. The origins are never listed.

Column.description: A typed column. `scale`, `currency` and `unit` are omitted when empty.

filters.description: S20-A (ADR 0023): the columns a query of this version may narrow by, each with its operators, an optional closed list of values and whether a filter on it is required. Omitted when the version declares none: then a query carries no filter.

sorts.description: S20-A (ADR 0023): the columns a query of this version may order by, each with its directions. Omitted when the version declares none: then a query carries no sort.

data_class.description: S08-A (ADR 0012 decision 6): where the data of this dataset comes from, the word of the adapter of the connection it is read through. It is the platform's word about the connection, not a field the source publishes; the evidence of every result of the dataset says the same word.

Dataset.description: An entry of the catalog: a published dataset version (reporting.Dataset) and the data class of its connection. The filters and sorts it declares are part of the version, as the columns are.

DataClass.description: S08-A (ADR 0012 decision 6): where data comes from, in the word of the adapter it is read through. `contract-simulator`: a contract simulator's synthetic data, never real business data. `manual-entry`: data people typed in or pasted (the manual source), not a source product's. `business-data`: a source product's data, which is what every adapter that says nothing serves (the generic `http` adapter among them). The set is closed. It is not the `X-Reporting-Data-Class` header, which says what kind of server answers.

field.description: A column id of the dataset.

operators.description: The operators the field takes: `prefix` and `contains` for string columns only; `lt`, `le`, `gt`, `ge`, `between` and `in` for date, integer, decimal and string columns; a boolean column takes `eq` and `ne` only.

values.description: Optional: the closed list of values the field accepts; an `eq`, `ne` or `in` filter must take its values from it.

required.description: true: a query must carry exactly one filter on this field.

FilterSpec.description: One filter a dataset version publishes (reporting.FilterSpec).

field.description: A column id of the dataset.

SortSpec.description: One sort key a dataset version publishes (reporting.SortSpec).

id.description: The value a query names in `company_ids`.

name.description: What a person reads; never stored by the platform.

Company.description: One company the principal may choose (reporting.Company, ADR 0015).

supported.description: Whether the integration's source product can list the principal's companies. False: the list is empty and the console keeps its text input.

partial.description: True when the product cut the list (the platform accepts at most 1000 entries); the person may still type an id. False when `supported` is false.

companies.description: The companies the principal may choose now, in the product's order, no id twice; `[]` when nothing may be chosen or the capability is absent.

CompanyDirectory.description: The answer of GET /companies (reporting.CompanyDirectoryAnswer, ADR 0015 decision 3): exactly these three keys.

field.description: A field the dataset version declares a filter on (`filters` of the catalog entry).

operator.description: One of the operators the entry declares for the field.

value.description: Well formed for the column: a date `YYYY-MM-DD`, an integer or a decimal as the column writes it (exactly its scale), `true` or `false`, a string of 1..128 characters without control characters; from the declared closed list when the field has one and the operator is `eq`, `ne` or `in`. For `in` and `between` a JSON array of such strings as text, `["a","b"]`: 1..32 values for `in`, exactly 2 in ascending order for `between`.

filters.description: S20-A (ADR 0023): at most 16 filters, a conjunction, each within what the catalog entry declares; a filter the entry does not declare (field, operator, a malformed value, a required field missing or filtered twice) is 422 UNSUPPORTED_COMBINATION. The source applies them and its totals are the narrowed scope's; the query hash and the frozen snapshot carry them. Empty narrows nothing, as before.

field.description: A field the dataset version declares a sort on (`sorts` of the catalog entry).

sort.description: S20-A (ADR 0023): at most 3 sort keys in the order they apply, each on a declared field in a declared direction, no field twice; anything else is 422 UNSUPPORTED_COMBINATION. The source orders the rows, stable across its pages. Empty is the source's own order, as before.

timezone.description: An IANA zone; must be the dataset's.

QuerySpec.description: A query of one published catalog entry (reporting.QuerySpec; examples in docs/s00/contracts/query-examples.json). A shape the entry does not declare is 422 UNSUPPORTED_COMBINATION; so is a filter or a sort outside the entry's `filters` and `sorts` (S20-A, ADR 0023).

rows.description: Cells are strings in the declared type; no number is converted through a float.

totals.description: The metric totals of the full authorized result, by column id.

rows.description: Cells are strings in the declared type; no number is converted through a float.

totals.description: The metric totals of the full authorized result, by column id.

next_cursor.description: Absent on the last page. An HMAC cursor bound to the owner, product, query and snapshot; it confers no access by itself.

RowsPage.description: A page of frozen snapshot rows (reporting.RowsPage). The source is not read again.

IssueGroup.description: The row group of a schema 2.0 issue (reporting.IssueGroupView).

ref.description: The source product's reference of the cancellation.

cancelled_at.description: The product's time, RFC 3339 in UTC, a whole second, not before `confirmed_at`.

reason.description: The reason the person gave, as the platform recorded it: 1..200 characters on one line.

IssueCancellation.description: The cancellation of an issued document (S24-A, ADR 0025; reporting.IssueCancellationView): what the source product answered when the platform asked it, and the reason. Present only on an issue the product cancelled; shown to the issue's owner and to nobody else.

number.description: The source product's number, once the job succeeded.

row_index.description: A row issue; absent for a group issue.

IssueSummary.description: What an issue job says about itself (reporting.IssueSummary).

format.description: Present for a non-workbook export and for an issue (`pdf`).

expired.description: Present (true) for a succeeded job whose results are no longer served (S04-B).

layout.description: Present for an export job that carries a layout (S23-A, ADR 0024): the layout version the file is rendered through. Absent for an export of the whole snapshot and for every other kind.

JobView.description: A job as its owner sees it (reporting.JobView). Empty fields are omitted.

integration_id.description: The product the issue was made under (S24-A): the key of `issue_cancellation` in the capabilities.

number.description: The source product's number, once the job succeeded.

row_index.description: A row issue; absent for a group issue.

IssueView.description: An issue job and, once it succeeded, its permanent record (reporting.IssueView). The record fields are absent before then.

ReleaseState.description: The release history of a saved document (privatedocs.ReleaseState).

version.description: The version to publish; ignored by withdraw.

expected_revision.description: The revision read; a stale one is 409.

schema_version.description: 1.0 picks, orders and aligns (left, right) the columns. 1.1 (S23-A, ADR 0024) adds, all optional: title, footnote, a column's label and format, center, subtotals and marks; a 1.0 document carrying any of them is 400.

title.description: 1.1. Printed above the table by the exports; a literal, never a value.

footnote.description: 1.1. Printed under the total row by the exports.

label.description: 1.1. Replaces the dataset's label (and its currency and unit) in the header.

by.description: The id of a column of the layout that is a dimension of the dataset. The rows are partitioned by its exact strings, the groups ordered by their first row; after each group a 小计 row carries the exact sum of each shown metric. The source's 合计 row is not recomputed.

marks.description: 1.1. Conditional marks: the first rule that holds colours the cell.

LayoutDocument.description: A report layout (layouts.Document): at most 64 KiB as JSON; distinct column ids of the bound dataset. A format on a column that is not decimal or integer, a subtotal column that is not a dimension, a mark whose relation does not fit its column's type, or a mark or subtotal column that is not in the layout are 400 INVALID_REQUEST; a column the dataset does not have is 403.

grouping.description: Thousands separators in the integer part.

LayoutFormat.description: How a decimal or integer column shows its digits (layouts.Format, 1.1). It changes which digits are shown never: no rounding, scaling or unit conversion. An absent key takes its default.

when.description: lt le gt ge eq ne on a decimal or integer column (an exact decimal comparison with value, an exact decimal string); eq ne blank on any other column (an exact string comparison; blank is the empty string and takes no value).

mark.description: A closed palette with one colour each, the same on screen, in the PDF and in the workbook. A mark colours a cell; it never hides a row, changes a value or adds text.

LayoutMark.description: One conditional rule of a 1.1 layout (layouts.Mark).

LayoutRef.description: The layout version an export job was rendered through (reporting.LayoutRef, S23-A).

LayoutEntry.description: A saved layout version. Note the key `layout`, where dashboards and templates say `config`.

id.description: Empty for a new layout, else its id.

expected_version.description: 0 for a new layout, else the latest version read.

DashboardWidgetTitle.description: S21-A: a widget's title, shown in place of its default heading: 1 to 64 characters, none of them a control character (Unicode Cc).

DashboardWidgetWidth.description: S21-A: a widget's width in the dashboard's two-column grid; absent means half.

oneOf.description: A chart over the current page's rows: a bar (S03-C4), a line or a pie (S21-A), of a category column and a numeric field. The console draws them; the server keeps the binding.

DashboardWidget.description: One widget, in the exact field set of its type (dashboards.Widget), plus the optional title and width (S21-A).

DashboardDocument.description: A dashboard (dashboards.Document): at most 64 KiB as JSON.

DocumentSummary.description: A saved dashboard in the listing: the latest version.

page.description: 2.x: the page preset and overprint profile.

TemplateDocument.description: A document template (doctemplates.Document). The server validates the exact closed form of each schema version; the nested shapes are documented in docs/ADR_0004_TEMPLATE_SCHEMA_2.md, docs/ADR_0005_BARCODES_IMAGES.md and docs/STUDIO.md and are not repeated here.

last_opened.description: RFC 3339 time of the last read of a version; empty until then.

TemplateCatalog.description: The template centre's metadata of one template (S06-B).

TemplateCatalogUpdate.description: The whole metadata, without `last_opened`; a name is one line without surrounding spaces.

name.description: Empty when the latest version has none.

preset.description: The page preset of a 2.x template; empty for 1.x.

TemplateSummary.description: A template in the listing: the latest version, without opening it.

version.description: Must be the published version (else 409 TEMPLATE_NOT_PUBLISHED).

group.description: A schema 2.0 template's group by its key values, in the order of the template's group fields.

IssueRequest.description: Exactly one of `row_index` and `group`; a 1.x template takes `row_index` only.

reason.description: Why the document is cancelled: 1..200 characters (not bytes) of text on one line, not blank, without control characters. It is sent to the source product and kept with the cancellation; it never reaches a log, a metric or a refusal.

SampleSummary.description: A sample of the pack as a card shows it: no rows and no document.

rows.description: The sample's own rows, by slot id.

Sample.description: One sample in full; its document is bound to no dataset and names slots in place of columns.

name.description: Empty or absent: the sample's name.

mapping.description: By slot id; a slot not mapped is the literal `[<label>]`.

png.description: A PNG of at most 512 KiB, in standard base64.

image.description: A PNG or JPEG of at most 512 KiB and 2000 x 2000 pixels, in standard base64; the format is read from the content.

reasons.description: Why a boundary sample picked the row.

enabled.description: false when the deployment configures no sign-in (the core API's answer, and then the only member); true with every other member (WithSignIn).

authorization_endpoint.description: Where the browser is sent: https://, no query or fragment.

redirect_uri.description: The one registered redirect URI, the console's page: https://host[:port]/console/.

paste_fallback.description: Whether the console still shows its paste-a-token form under the sign-in button.

SignInConfig.description: What the console needs to start the authorization request, or {"enabled": false}. Nothing secret: no token endpoint, no client secret. With enabled true every member is present.

code.description: The authorization code from the redirect (printable ASCII).

code_verifier.description: The PKCE verifier whose S256 challenge the authorization request carried.

nonce.description: The nonce of the authorization request; compared with the ID token's when the provider returns one.

access_token.description: The provider's access token, already accepted by this server's verifier; used as the Bearer token of every request.

expires_in.description: Present when the provider said it.

Recurrence.description: Every day, one day of the week or one day of the month at a wall-clock time in an IANA zone; no free-form expression. A time the zone skips or repeats on a day runs once that day.

weekday.description: weekly only, and required there: 1 Monday .. 7 Sunday (ISO 8601).

timezone.description: An IANA zone name such as Asia/Shanghai, or UTC; not Local.

name.description: Bytes of UTF-8; no control character; not blank.

export_format.description: Absent: the run freezes the snapshot only. `xlsx` or a format of GET /capabilities: the run exports it too (422 for one the server does not write).

as_of.description: The as_of of each run's query: the occurrence's date in the recurrence's zone, the day before it, or the query's own.

next_run_at.description: The next occurrence, UTC; only while active.

due_at.description: The occurrence; a run caught up after a downtime keeps the oldest missed one.

state.description: refused: the owner is no longer bound, lacks the viewer role, or the source product refused the read. cancelled: the schedule was paused or deleted before the run started, or the owner cancelled its job.

error_code.description: A job's code, AUTH_SCOPE_DENIED, AUTH_ROLE_DENIED, QUOTA_EXCEEDED, RUN_TIMEOUT, JOB_CANCELLED, SCHEDULE_PAUSED or SCHEDULE_DELETED.

delivery.description: The delivery of the run's end to the deployment's deliverers (the webhook, the owner's email; S16-B: with both, the attempt as a whole); none when the deployment configures neither.

version.description: The server's build version (`demo` in the demo).

connections_sha256.description: The digest of the configuration's connections, as the start line logs it.

bindings_sha256.description: The digest of the bindings file in force, as the start and reload lines log it.

webhook_host.description: The webhook URL's host (and port); never its path or query.

adapter.description: The adapter's registered name; its options are never shown.

roles.description: null: the binding names no role and has the default roles (viewer, designer, publisher, issuer).
